title: Shopify Bundles Without an App | Gain, a Ready-Made Fashion Store #Shorts
description:
A ready-made Shopify theme for fashion brands: Gain. Bundles are built in, no app needed. We tapped through its real demo:
• Your shopper builds a full look right on the home page
• Color and size: two taps per piece
• The same two taps for piece two and piece three
• The whole set goes to cart with one button

You don't have to build any of this. We already did, so your store is ready on day one.

Gain is a ready-made store for fashion brands in the official Shopify Theme Store. $100, one payment, yours forever. Try it free with no time limit — you pay only when you publish your store.

🔗 Link to the theme is in our channel profile.
